caption: The drawing features a symmetrical, stylized floral and aquatic design, primarily composed of yellow, teal, and reddish-brown colors. At the center top, there is a tulip-like flower with three prominent petals and a circular center, outlined and accented in reddish-brown and filled with yellow and teal. Below it, a larger cup-shaped or shell-like element shares the same color scheme. Extending horizontally from the lower center are two curved, scroll-like lines ending in circles, rendered in yellow and outlined in reddish-brown. Flanking these scrolls, there are two stylized teal fish, each facing outward with simple dot eyes and reddish-brown line details near the gills. At the base of the central motif is an oval-shaped, yellow and reddish-brown platform with teal detailing above it. Two circular flower motifs sit in the upper left and right corners, both with petals radiating from a center, filled with teal and yellow, and surrounded by a reddish-brown outline. Each flower is connected to a teal stem that curls downward and features teal leaves or tendrils. The entire composition is arranged symmetrically on a light beige background.
title: San Juan Capistrano Mission Border Design from the portfolio "Decorative Art of Spanish California"
